summary: All 16 quoted Scriptures verify KJV-verbatim against the Ruth/Gal/Titus/Eph passage; first-person narrative facts (ten elders, the nearer kinsman drawing off his shoe, Obed-Jesse-David line, Moab's tenth-generation reproach) are accurate, and the goel-to-Christ thread lands on Jesus with a grace-anchored, fear-free CTA.
